approaches.method: Exact Burau polynomial and Fox-Milnor obstruction
approaches.result: Identical degree-16 Alexander polynomials; norm condition for difference passes; determinant 243 and genus 8.
approaches.gap: Polynomial data do not establish algebraic or smooth concordance.

approaches.method: Full Levine-Tristram functions through cospectral brick trees
approaches.result: Exact matching-polynomial certificate and unitary tree gauge prove identical whole signature/nullity functions; standard signature -14.
approaches.gap: These legitimate signature obstructions vanish on the difference; other algebraic obstructions are not exhausted.

approaches.method: Branched-double-cover homology and discriminant linking form
approaches.result: Nonisomorphic groups prove non-isotopy, while an explicit metabolizer proves the difference linking form is metabolic.
approaches.gap: Different homology groups do not imply non-concordance; Casson-Gordon and Floer correction terms remain uncomputed.

approaches.method: Floer-derived smooth homomorphisms and reconstruction scope
approaches.result: tau=8, s=16, Upsilon(1)=-7 for both; neither knot is L-space or quasi-alternating, so those polynomial-to-complex shortcuts fail.
approaches.gap: No full filtered complex, full Upsilon function, or stronger Floer concordance invariant has been computed.

approaches.method: Explicit saddle cobordism and tight-fibered ribbon obstruction
approaches.result: Six named oriented saddles give genus at most 3; Baker's theorem forbids a ribbon disk for the difference and homotopy-ribbon concordance either way.
approaches.gap: Genus zero remains possible by these tests; non-ribbon is not non-slice.
